title: Quick Indulgent Korean Green Pepper Gui Jjigae
description: A salty, cheesy, and indulgent Korean dish from Gyeongsang Province, featuring green peppers cooked to an al-dente finish on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Heat a binchotan grill to medium-high heat.
Cut the green peppers into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, and gochugaru.
In a large binchotan grill pan, heat 1 tsp of sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the minced onion and cook for 2-3 minutes, until translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the mixed gochujang sauce and cook for 1 minute, until bubbly.
Add the green pepper pieces and cook for 4-5 minutes, until slightly charred, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle the Korean cheese on top of the green peppers and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Transfer the gui to a serving platter and garnish with green onions.
